note.question: How does a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) approach contribute to an appointment scheduling problem involving multiple sequential servers?
note.overview: This paper addresses an appointment scheduling problem involving multiple sequential servers using a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) approach. Two decisions are optimized: the schedule for patient visits and an adjusting policy to rebalance customers’ waiting time across servers. The paper formulates the distributionally robust appointment scheduling problem in sequential-servers systems using conic optimization, incorporating service time correlations.
